description.value: Driftwood Brewery is a Victoria-area craft brewery that has been crafting award-winning ales and lagers since 2008, now operating out of a full production facility on Viewfield Road in Esquimalt. The on-site Driftwood Bar + Patio (opened November 2021) lets visitors enjoy pints in a working brewery atmosphere. A retail store with growler fills rounds out the experience, making it a natural stop for cyclists exploring the western edge of Greater Victoria.
